title: Fluent English parent, relocating
turns: Hi, I'm relocating from Bangalore next month and I'm looking at Class 7 admission for my son. Could you tell me about the school?
What's the student teacher ratio, and how big are the classes?
Do you have a school bus from Jagatpura?
Great, and what about mid-session admission since we're moving in December?
Thanks, that's helpful. Bye.
check: Replies fully in English including the acknowledgment; no invented class size; Jagatpura is far so transport desk; mid-session office will check; hangs up at bye.
